summary: Updated implementation plan to move the prayer title ("Jumu'ah الجمعة") directly below "NEXT PRAYER" / "CURRENT PRAYER" at the top-left of the Hero Card, change the Screen 1 (Lock & Alert) prayer title from "Jumu'ah Prayer" to "Jumu'ah الجمعة", and move the "Next prayer in xxxy" countdown text on Screen 1 from below the Jama'ah pill to above the left side of the loading bar (replacing the previous left progress label).
